[nation]Oceanice Republics[/nation] 

Due to the world's focus on the Kaiserreich-THEP war there has been a lack of adequate protection of shipping lanes, especially in the Argos straight. The region has seen a rise in piracy, threatening international shipping and exports of both Lavia and Oceanice. Because of this threat, we must bring forward the suggestion of ignoring the blatant rivalry between both nations and come together to once again secure the straight until the region returns to its normal state. The ULR proposes the idea that both navies pool together ships and resources to not only patrol their share of the straight, but the entirety of the mass to ensure the continuation of both nation's economies and logistics industries.

The Oceanice Republic acknowledges receipt of the United Lavian Republics proposal regarding enhanced maritime security operations within the Argos Strait. We recognize the growing threat posed by piracy in the region and the risks such instability poses to international shipping, economic security, and the logistical networks upon which both our nations depend.

In this emerging threat, we will help cooperation and mutual economic interest, the Oceanice Republic agrees to participate in a Joint Naval Security Mission with the United Lavian Republic. We believe in signing the Terms of Agreement. 

In the agreement, a One-Year Truce, both nations agree to suspend hostilities for 12 months. Mutual Naval access to each others territorial waters for anti-piracy operations. A Joint Command to ensure equal representation in a combined naval operational command. Unified Patrol Zone to full coverage of the Argos Strait without territorial restrictions. Resource Pooling, we will ensure backup support from our ships, aircraft, and logistics assets. A joint Intelligence Sharing to secure real-time communications and coordinated threat response. The Agreement is reviewed after 12 months for both sides, easing our rivalry tensions.
